headline: Argentina wholesale inflation slows to 1.6% in October on energy moderation
summary: Wholesale prices in Argentina rose 1.6% in October according to Indec data, decelerating due to lower monthly oil price gains, though analysts noted retail consumer inflation may not see immediate relief.
why: Wholesale inflation in Argentina serves as an upstream leading indicator for consumer inflation and official interest-rate policy under President Javier Milei.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Wholesale inflation easing to 1.6% indicates ongoing deceleration in domestic producer prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
